player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Craft room and Music room, repeatedly going east and then west. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I never noticed that I was visiting the same rooms over and over again. Next time, I will keep track of the rooms I have visited and avoid revisiting them. I will also try to explore new rooms by taking a new, untried direction instead of repeating the same moves. If I notice that I'm stuck in a loop, I will take a step back and try to find a new path.
